newsitem.title: USA: Illinois March unemployment unchanged over Feb..
newsitem.headline: Illinois March unemployment unchanged over Feb..

text.p: Illinois recorded a seasonally-adjusted unemployment rate of 5 percent for March, unchanged over February, the Illinois Department of Employment Security reported Tuesday.
The unemployment rate remained below the national average of 5.2 percent for the month and reflected a drop from the 5.3 percent rate recorded in March 1996, the IDES reported.

A moderate growth pace for payroll jobs, a near record average for weekly hours for manufacturing workers and an unemployment rate that has remained at or below 5.3 percent for more than two years all suggest that Illinois is on a health course, according to IDES Director Lynn Doherty.
